SHA-256: e47f439504d3892267f89a334d66c461167ec0134492bf8a5470ede4262f5c82

`src/rrformats/hd_contours.h` adapts the edge rules to offline CPU processing of palette indices (after the Gran Turismo 2 PC & VR port's `src/gt2formats/ui_contours.h`, the same authors). The original shader is retained for provenance and is not executed by the game.
